flowTitle: Default Department/Ward Selection in IP Case Sheet Receive Menu
purpose: Define the functional requirement for displaying the user's default department/ward in the department/ward selection dropdown of the IP Case Sheet Receive in Department menu when the user is a super user.
scope: Applies to the inpatient (IP) module where MRD users receive case sheets in departments/wards. Super users have their mapped department/ward pre-selected and can change it; other users select the department/ward manually.
trigger: User opens the IP Case Sheet Receive in Department menu when a case sheet has come to the department.

preConditions.text: A case sheet has been sent to the department/ward and is awaiting receipt.
For super users: the user is mapped to a default department/ward in user mapping.

postConditions.text: The selected patients' case sheets are received in the chosen department/ward.

steps.screen: IP Case Sheet Receive in Department

steps.action: Pre-selects the super user's mapped default department/ward in the dropdown.
steps.screen: IP Case Sheet Receive in Department

steps.action: Selects the department/ward manually from the dropdown.
steps.screen: IP Case Sheet Receive in Department

steps.action: Selects the patients whose case sheets are to be received.
steps.screen: IP Case Sheet Receive in Department
IP Case Sheet Receive in Department

decisions.condition: Is the user a super user?

alternateFlows.name: Super user changes the pre-selected department/ward
alternateFlows.condition: The super user wants to receive case sheets for a department/ward other than the pre-selected one.
steps: Super user selects a different department/ward from the dropdown.

businessRules.rule: For a super user, the department/ward dropdown defaults to the department/ward assigned in user mapping.
A super user can change the pre-selected department/ward.
For users who are not super users, no department/ward is pre-selected and the dropdown works as before.

screens.menuName: IP Case Sheet Receive in Department

fields.name: Department/Ward
fields.defaultValue: Mapped department/ward for super users; no selection for other users

integrations.description: Supplies the user's super-user status and mapped default department/ward to the IP Case Sheet Receive in Department menu.

requirements.description: Default Department/Ward Selection in IP Case Sheet Receive Menu: pre-select the super user's mapped department/ward (changeable); no pre-selection for other users.

acceptanceCriteria.given: A super user is mapped to a default department/ward
acceptanceCriteria.when: the user opens the IP Case Sheet Receive in Department menu
acceptanceCriteria.then: the department/ward dropdown shows the mapped department/ward as selected

acceptanceCriteria.given: A super user sees the pre-selected department/ward
acceptanceCriteria.when: the user selects a different department/ward in the dropdown
acceptanceCriteria.then: the dropdown accepts and shows the newly selected department/ward

acceptanceCriteria.given: A user who is not a super user
acceptanceCriteria.when: the user opens the IP Case Sheet Receive in Department menu
acceptanceCriteria.then: no department/ward is pre-selected and the user selects one manually

userRoles.menuName: IP Case Sheet Receive in Department

useCase.mainScenario: The user opens the IP Case Sheet Receive in Department menu. For a super user the mapped department/ward is pre-selected and can be changed; other users select it manually. The user then selects the patients and receives the case sheets.

gaps.description: Behaviour is not stated when a super user is mapped to more than one department/ward.
It is not stated whether the department/ward chosen by the user is remembered for the session or the default is re-applied each time the menu opens.
It is not stated what the dropdown shows when a super user has no default department/ward mapped.

clarificationQuestions.question: If a super user is mapped to multiple wards, which one should be pre-selected?
Should the department/ward the user selects be remembered for the session, or reset to the default every time the menu opens?
What should the dropdown show when a super user has no default department/ward mapped?
